MATCH (i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p:Person) WITH i, p.personKey AS pk
MATCH (i)-[r]-(j:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q:Person) WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND q.personKey<>pk
WITH collect(DISTINCT [i.issueKey,j.issueKey,type(r),r.linkId]) AS e
RETURN size(e)

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[rs*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE all(r IN rs WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT')
AND all(r IN rs WHERE EXISTS{(startNode(r))-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x) MATCH (endNode(r))-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE x<>y})
AND a.issueKey<b.issueKey AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))=size(nodes(p))
WITH p,a,b
WHERE NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN nodes(p) AND EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x) WHERE false} } 
RETURN count(*)

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[rs*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey AND all(r IN rs WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT')
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns, rs
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..])
AND all(n IN ns WHERE EXISTS{(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()})
AND all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE head([(ns[i])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey]) <> head([(ns[i+1])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey]))
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(z) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND z.personKey<>head([(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r2]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(z) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND z.personKey<>head([(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])}
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN rs|r.linkId] AS links, [n IN ns|head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS people, [n IN ns|head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(x)|x.projectKey])] AS projects, [r IN rs|type(r)] AS types

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p:Person) WITH collect([i.issueKey,p.personKey]) AS prs
WITH apoc.map.fromPairs(prs) AS m
MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[rs*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey AND all(r IN rs WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT')
WITH m,p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns, rs
WHERE all(n IN ns WHERE m[n.issueKey] IS NOT NULL)
AND all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE m[ns[i].issueKey]<>m[ns[i+1].issueKey])
AND all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..])
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND m[c.issueKey] IS NOT NULL AND m[c.issueKey]<>m[a.issueKey]}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND m[c.issueKey] IS NOT NULL AND m[c.issueKey]<>m[b.issueKey]}
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN rs|r.linkId] AS links, [n IN ns|m[n.issueKey]] AS people, [n IN ns|head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(x)|x.projectKey])] AS projects, [r IN rs|type(r)] AS types

MATCH p=(a:Issue)((x:Issue)-[r]-(y:Issue) WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u) MATCH (y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5}(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns, relationships(p) AS rs
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..])
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u) MATCH (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND EXISTS{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u) MATCH (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}}
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN rs|r.linkId] AS links, [n IN ns|head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS people, [n IN ns|head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(x)|x.projectKey])] AS projects, [r IN rs|type(r)] AS types

MATCH p=(a:Issue)((x:Issue)-[r]-(y:Issue) WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u), (y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5}(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns, relationships(p) AS rs
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..])
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(c:Issue), (a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND u<>v}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r2]-(c:Issue), (b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND u<>v}
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN rs|r.linkId] AS links, [n IN ns|head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS people, [n IN ns|head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(x)|x.projectKey])] AS projects, [r IN rs|type(r)] AS types

MATCH p=(a:Issue)((x:Issue)-[r]-(y:Issue) WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u), (y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5}(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns, relationships(p) AS rs
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..])
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(c:Issue), (a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND u<>v}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r2]-(c:Issue), (b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE type(r2)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND NOT c IN ns AND u<>v}
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [i IN range(0,size(rs)-1)|ns[i].issueKey] AS src, [r IN rs|r.linkId] AS links
